summary: Gamehaus Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing an At The Market Offering Agreement dated November 10, 2026 with ARC Group Securities LLC as sales agent for up to US$11,642,197 of Class A ordinary shares. Sales occur under an effective Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-297738) via Nasdaq or privately negotiated trades at the company's instruction. Agent compensation is 3.0% of gross proceeds plus documented expense reimbursement. The cap reflects the one-third non-affiliate float limit under Form F-3 General Instruction I.B.5, with non-affiliate market value near US$34.9 million. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
